utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Call the case, please, Mr. Court deputy.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. Case number IT-95-17-PT, the Prosecutor versus Miroslav Bralo. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Could I have the appearances, please, for the Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. For the Prosecution, Daryl Mundis.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. And for Defence?

utterances.speaker: MR. COOPER
utterances.text: May it please Your Honour, my name is Jonathan Cooper and I appear for Miroslav Bralo.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Bralo, can you hear the proceedings in a language you understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Thank you very much. You may sit down, please. This is a Status Conference with accordance with Rule 65 bis. I have two tasks in this Status Conference. One is to organise changes between the parties so as to ensure the expeditious preparation for the trial. Second, to review the status of the case and to allow the accused the opportunity to raise issues in relation thereto, including the mental and physical conditions of the accused. So the first issue I would like to ask to the parties, that is about the disclosure issues. Yes, Mr. Mundis?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Thank, Your Honour. My understanding is that the disclosure is being conducted pursuant to the rules. We have just, in fact, disclosed some additional information or material to my learned colleague for the Defence and my understanding is that everything is proceeding smoothly with respect to disclosure.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Cooper could I get confirmation from your side?

utterances.speaker: MR. COOPER
utterances.text: Your Honour, I confirm that the process of disclosure is continuing and I'm grateful for the cooperation of the Office of the Prosecutor in that respect.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Any other matters that the parties would like to inform me?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Nothing further from the Prosecution, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: And Defence?

utterances.speaker: MR. COOPER
utterances.text: And nothing further from the Defence, thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: I see. Mr. Bralo, do you have any issue relating to your mental and physical condition which you would like to raise directly with me?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Do you have any complaints during your stay in the Detention Unit?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, you may sit down, please.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [In English] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, I understand that there is still some time before the trial of this case, but however, I believe that the parties should be prepared, and do everything possible to facilitate the preparations. So I believe there is no other matters that the parties would like to raise at this stage. Well, the next Status Conference will take place no later than 120 days from today, which brings us towards July 2005. The Trial Chamber will issue a scheduling order when we have set an exact date for the next conference. Well, I believe that the hearing is over.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
